bodies: National Registry of Food Safety Professionals

exams.name: WSET Level 1 Award in Wines
exams.blurb: Beginner wine qualification with a thirty-question examination on main grape varieties, styles, storage and food pairing.

exams.name: WSET Level 2 Award in Wines
exams.blurb: Intermediate wine qualification examining grape varieties, principal regions, production factors and systematic tasting.

exams.name: WSET Level 3 Award in Wines
exams.blurb: Advanced wine qualification with multiple-choice, short-written and blind tasting papers on production factors and style drivers.

exams.name: WSET Level 4 Diploma in Wines
exams.blurb: Six-unit expert qualification covering wine production, business, regions, sparkling and fortified wines plus an independent assignment.

exams.name: Certified Specialist of Spirits
exams.blurb: Written examination covering distillation, spirit categories, production regions, regulation and responsible service.

exams.name: Certified Specialist of Wine
exams.blurb: Hundred-question written examination on viticulture, vinification, wine regions, laws and faults with no tasting component.

exams.name: Certified Wine Educator
exams.blurb: Advanced credential combining theory, essay, blind tasting and a teaching demonstration for professional wine instructors.

exams.name: FSPCA Foreign Supplier Verification Programs Course
exams.blurb: FDA-recognised curriculum training importers to evaluate foreign suppliers and document verification activities under FSMA.

exams.name: FSPCA Preventive Controls Qualified Individual – Animal Food
exams.blurb: FDA-recognised course qualifying individuals to develop and oversee animal food safety plans required under FSMA rules.

exams.name: FSPCA Preventive Controls Qualified Individual – Human Food
exams.blurb: Standardised FSMA curriculum qualifying staff to write and manage hazard analysis and risk-based preventive controls plans.

exams.name: Certified Travel Associate
exams.blurb: Credential for travel advisers with at least a year of experience, covering destinations, selling skills and client service.

exams.name: Certified Travel Counselor
exams.blurb: Advanced travel adviser credential covering management, marketing strategy and business development for experienced counsellors.

exams.name: Certified Travel Industry Executive
exams.blurb: Executive credential for travel suppliers and agency leaders covering distribution strategy, finance and industry management.

exams.name: Learn2Serve Alcohol Seller-Server Training
exams.blurb: National responsible alcohol service course on intoxication signs, age verification and liability, with separate state-approved versions.

exams.name: Learn2Serve Food Protection Manager Certification
exams.blurb: ANSI-CFP accredited manager-level food safety examination covering temperature control, contamination, cleaning and HACCP basics.

exams.name: Certified Meeting Professional
exams.blurb: Leading meetings credential examining strategic planning, project management, risk, site selection, marketing and stakeholders.

exams.name: Certified Meeting Professional – Healthcare
exams.blurb: Subspecialty for CMP holders covering healthcare meeting compliance, transparency reporting and continuing education requirements.

exams.name: ACS Certified Cheese Professional
exams.blurb: Examination covering cheesemaking, affinage, handling, sales and regulation for cheesemongers, buyers and cheesemakers.

exams.name: Always Food Safe Food Protection Manager Certification
exams.blurb: ANSI-CFP accredited food protection manager examination delivered online with remote proctoring and accepted by most jurisdictions.

exams.name: BarSmarts Advanced
exams.blurb: Spirits and cocktail curriculum with a written examination and practical drink-making assessment for professional bartenders.

exams.name: BJCP Beer Judge Examination
exams.blurb: Online entrance examination plus tasting examination that ranks beer judges from Recognized through National and Master levels.

exams.name: BRCGS Professional
exams.blurb: Structured training and examination programme on the BRCGS global food safety standard for site practitioners and auditors.

exams.name: Certified Dietary Manager, Certified Food Protection Professional
exams.blurb: Credentialing examination for foodservice directors in healthcare and schools covering nutrition, sanitation and department management.

exams.name: Certified Professional – Food Safety
exams.blurb: Credential for food safety professionals and regulators covering inspection, risk assessment, HACCP and outbreak investigation.

exams.name: HACCP Manager Certification
exams.blurb: Accredited training and examination on the seven HACCP principles, prerequisite programmes and food safety plan verification.

exams.name: IACP Certified Culinary Professional
exams.blurb: Credential for food writers, teachers and consultants assessed on culinary knowledge, communication and professional practice.

exams.name: KCBS Certified Barbecue Judge
exams.blurb: Class and assessment training judges to score competition barbecue on appearance, taste and tenderness under sanctioned rules.

exams.name: NRFSP Food Protection Manager Certification
exams.body: National Registry of Food Safety Professionals
exams.blurb: ANSI-CFP accredited manager certification examination accepted by state and local health departments across the country.

exams.name: Produce Safety Alliance Grower Training
exams.blurb: FDA-recognised course satisfying the Produce Safety Rule requirement for at least one trained supervisor per covered farm.

exams.name: Prometric Certified Professional Food Manager
exams.blurb: ANSI-CFP accredited food protection manager examination delivered at Prometric centres and through approved remote proctoring.

exams.name: Q Arabica Grader Certification
exams.blurb: Multi-day sensory and analytical examination series licensing graders to score arabica coffee against international standards.

exams.name: SCA Coffee Skills Program Professional Diploma
exams.blurb: Modular written and practical assessments across barista skills, brewing, green coffee, roasting and sensory analysis.

exams.name: SQF Practitioner Training
exams.blurb: Required training pathway for the site practitioner who maintains a Safe Quality Food system under the SQF codes.

exams.name: StateFoodSafety Certified Food Protection Manager
exams.blurb: ANSI-CFP accredited food protection manager examination offered in testing centres and via online proctoring nationwide.

exams.name: TIPS Alcohol Server Certification
exams.blurb: Long-established responsible alcohol service training and test used nationally, with separate state-approved course versions.

exams.name: Certified Club Manager
exams.blurb: Examination for private club managers covering governance, membership, food and beverage, golf operations and club finance.

exams.name: Certified Destination Management Executive
exams.blurb: Executive programme for destination marketing organisation leaders covering strategy, vision, stakeholder relations and change.

exams.name: Certified Government Meeting Professional
exams.blurb: Credential for planners working under federal travel and procurement rules, covering per diem, contracting and ethics.
